blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Tuesday thanked government agencies, civil servants, volunteers, hospitality workers, and support personnel for the “successful conduct” of the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and Related Summits. In a social media post on the evening of Nov. 17, when the Philippines turned over the Asean chairship to Singapore, Marcos recognized key agencies and groups that worked tirelessly for the high-level event.
